text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I go see Maruzensky during her
dance practice, and...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: One, two, and... finish! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's only just learned this number, but
pulls it off masterfully.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
That felt good! This upbeat song is
my jam. ♪ My body gets
into the rhythm
so naturally.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You've got that gleam in your eyes... just
like when we first met.
Hehe, it makes me
laugh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You've got that gleam in your eyes... just
like when we first met.
Hehe, it makes me
laugh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I'm happy you enjoyed it! "Have fun"
has become our little motto,
hasn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whether dancing or racing, it's all about
having fun while you do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding, dong, ding, dong...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's this late already? Guess we're
done for today then. Plus I
gotta get
going.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What, feeling jealous? Don't worry—it's
not a date or anything!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually,
there's this car expo going on...
And!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They're giving out miniature cars,
including
Tata's model! They're
super cute! I want
one sooo bad.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The giveaway starts at 7,
but it's a limited
edition, so I gotta hurry
there!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right,
sorry to rush off like this. I'll see you
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right,
sorry to rush off like this. I'll see you
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Maruzen! I'm so glad to see you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, kiddos! What's shaking?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You were just doing dance practice, right?! We really wanna see your moves!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Our instructor said your dancing's so
beautiful it'd be great to learn
from... So,
please! Pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well... Hehe, I can't say no when you ask
so nicely, can I? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, there's no substitute for their cute
little smiles. All right, get
ready, 'cause
here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky decides to continue her dance
practice for the younger
students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering how excited for the expo
she was, I look up the event
and head over
to get a miniature for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Another great day for training. ♪ I'm all
set! What's first on the menu?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hold the miniature car up to Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Wait, you didn't... Did you go to the
show for me?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Wait, you didn't... Did you go to the
show for me?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't it far? And you must have waited
so long in line.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's all 'cause I wouldn't shut up
about
it. I'm so sorry you had to
go all the way
there...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's all 'cause I wouldn't shut up
about
it. I'm so sorry you had to
go all the way
there...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aw, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aw, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did! I'm as happy as can be!
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! What are you doing after training? I
need to return the favor
for the miniature.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Get ready to have some mad
fun. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, Maruzensky and I go for a
drive in her prized car.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cool night's breeze blowing in our
hair, the occasional close call...
This is
quite the mad ride.
